name: _meta
script: return "HEIC 全链路：HEIC 缩略图上墙 → 灯箱 .heic 原图（协议层转 JPEG）+ EXIF 摄于日期 → ⌘K 命中 HEIC 图注。前置：macOS（gen-demo 用 sips 造 HEIC 样张）。"

name: 02-open-kyoto
script: const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(el => el.textContent.includes('京都')); if (!h) throw new Error('找不到京都'); h.click(); 'ok'

name: 03-wall-with-heic
script: const imgs = [...document.querySelectorAll('main img')]; const bad = imgs.filter(i => !(i.complete && i.naturalWidth > 0)); if (bad.length > 0) throw new Error('照片墙有未加载图 ' + bad.length); if (!document.body.textContent.match(/10 张照片/)) throw new Error('应为 10 张（8 jpg + 2 heic）'); 'wall-ok'

name: 04-open-heic-lightbox
script: const cap = [...document.querySelectorAll('main [role="button"]')].find(el => el.textContent.startsWith('HEIC 样张')); if (!cap) throw new Error('找不到 HEIC 卡片图注'); const card = cap.closest('.group'); const img = card?.querySelector('img'); if (!img) throw new Error('卡片内无 img'); img.click(); 'ok'

name: 05-lightbox-heic
script: const lb = document.querySelector('.fixed.inset-0.z-50'); if (!lb) throw new Error('灯箱未打开'); const img = lb.querySelector('img'); if (!img) throw new Error('灯箱无大图'); if (!(img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0)) throw new Error('HEIC 大图未加载'); if (!lb.textContent.includes('.heic')) throw new Error('信息栏文件名不是 .heic'); if (!lb.textContent.includes('摄于')) throw new Error('HEIC EXIF 缺失'); 'lightbox-ok'

name: 06-close-and-search
script: window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape' })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'k', metaKey: true })); 'ok'

name: 07-search-heic-caption
script: const inp = document.querySelector('input[placeholder^="搜索旅行标题"]'); if (!inp) throw new Error('搜索框缺失'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(inp, 'HEIC 样张'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); 'ok'

name: 08-search-hit
script: const hits = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(b => b.textContent.includes('京都')); if (hits.length === 0) throw new Error('⌘K 未命中 HEIC 图注'); 'search-ok'
